title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
source: Matrix using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with blistering Bertha, stellar China→Rider jam and Phil’s thumping bass.
ai_review.review: The matrix source delivers crystal‑clear sound that lets the band’s intensity shine through – from a lightning‑fast Bertha to an all‑time‑great China → Rider sequence.  While a few moments in the first set feel sloppy, the second half is fire‑filled with standout performances of Roses, Truckin’, Sugar Magnolia and emotionally charged Stella Blue.  Overall the show feels like a quintessential early‑’80s Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the musical performance and the matrix recording quality; only a few note sloppiness or technical hiccups, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the mix as top‑notch and crisp, with great soundstage; early technical glitches are mentioned but quickly resolved, leaving a clear, enveloping listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Crazy setlist with a strong start despite early technical issues; second set builds momentum with intense jams and fast tempos, delivering an overall high‑energy arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for expressive, fast playing (especially on Bertha), emotional fiddling and vocal quirks that add character; his tone is highlighted throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as thumping and delivering some of his finest bass work, especially on the high‑energy numbers.
